abstract: Medical large language models achieving high benchmark accuracy exhibit unexplained variability in clinical tasks, producing errors that clinicians cannot safeguard against. We evaluated clinical reasoning stability in GPT-5, MedGemma-27B-Text-IT, and OpenBioLLM-Llama3-70B using 3035 systematic perturbations from physician-validated oncology SOAP, brief vignette, and MIMIC cases. We trained sparse autoencoders on 1 billion tokens from 50,000 MIMIC-IV clinical notes to decompose their internal representation. We find models exhibit dramatic reasoning instability, shifting staging accuracy by over 50% based solely on prompt format, or generating definitive staging in clinically insufficient scenarios. Sparse autoencoder analysis revealed hierarchical encoding in MedGemma, where high-magnitude features encode lexical identity and low-magnitude features encode contextual meaning. OpenBioLLM distributes information uniformly. We demonstrate that these internal encoding structures differentially affect retrieval and reasoning interventions, suggesting interventions effective for one architecture may harm another. These results motivate architecture-specific safety validation as a component of pre-deployment evaluation for medical LLMs.

abstract: Clinical artificial intelligence (AI) often trades predictive performance against interpretability. This study develops an interpretability-driven feature engineering framework for multi-outcome risk stratification at hospitalization for chronic hepatitis B. A total of 36,024 hospitalization records from 22,001 patients were included. The framework integrating SHapley Additive exPlanations (SHAP)-based main and interaction effects was used to construct compact machine learning models for classifying disease non-progression, liver cirrhosis (LC), and hepatocellular carcinoma (HCC). SHAP main effects selected the top 15 features per outcome; TreeSHAP interactions selected four pairwise terms. Performance was evaluated using patient-level data splitting, temporal validation, and independent external validation, with calibration and decision-curve analyses. The full-feature models achieved superior discrimination (AUCs: 0.927, 0.897, and 0.899) for classifying hospitalization-recorded disease non-progression, LC, and HCC, respectively. The corresponding compact models maintained strong discrimination (AUCs: 0.911, 0.882, and 0.890) with 80.8% fewer features. Interaction models yielded subtle AUC shifts (AUCs: 0.912, 0.881, and 0.891) while characterizing potential clinical joint-effect patterns. Temporal validation yielded AUCs of 0.863, 0.827, and 0.847, while external validation yielded AUCs of 0.829, 0.865, and 0.827, respectively. The framework produced compact and transparent models for contemporaneous risk stratification in clinical practice, seamlessly uniting predictive accuracy with multi-level interpretability.

abstract: Persistent fever after initiating intravenous antibiotics is common in hospitalized patients with cancer and often leads to additional imaging and antimicrobial escalation. Early identification of patients unlikely to remain febrile could provide additional information during clinical reassessment. We developed and externally validated machine learning models to predict persistent fever 48-72 h after antibiotic initiation using electronic health records from two academic hospitals. Adult cancer patients with fever within 24-48 h of treatment were included. Models incorporated demographics, comorbidities, laboratory results, vital signs, and temperature patterns. The best-performing model achieved an AUROC of 0.82 (95% CI 0.79-0.84) internally and 0.78 (95% CI 0.77-0.79) externally. Temperature-related variables were the dominant predictors. Decision curve analysis demonstrated positive net benefit across much of the evaluated threshold range. Retrospective assessment suggested that approximately one quarter of antibiotic escalations and chest CT scans occurred in patients correctly predicted not to remain febrile, highlighting the potential contextual value of fever predictions. These findings indicate that short-term fever persistence can be predicted with clinically meaningful accuracy using routine data. However, clinical use should be limited to an adjunctive role rather than standalone rule-out decision-making, and prospective studies are required to evaluate safety, clinician uptake, and real-world impact.

abstract: Generating clinical synthetic text represents an effective solution for common clinical NLP issues like sparsity and privacy. This paper aims to conduct a systematic review on generating synthetic medical free-text by formulating quantitative analysis to three research questions concerning (i) the purpose of generation, (ii) the techniques, and (iii) the evaluation methods. We searched PubMed, ScienceDirect, Web of Science, Scopus, IEEE, Google Scholar, and arXiv databases for publications associated with generating synthetic medical unstructured free-text. We have identified 94 relevant articles out of 1,398 collected ones. A great deal of attention has been given to the generation of synthetic medical text from 2018 onwards, where the main purpose of such a generation is towards text augmentation, assistive writing, corpus building, privacy-preserving, annotation, and usefulness. Transformer architectures were the main predominant technique used to generate the text, especially the GPTs. On the other hand, there were four main aspects of evaluation, including similarity, privacy, structure, and utility, where utility was the most frequent method used to assess the generated synthetic medical text. Although the generated synthetic medical text demonstrated a moderate possibility to act as real medical documents in different downstream NLP tasks, it has proven to be a great asset as augmented, complementary to the real documents, towards improving the accuracy and overcoming sparsity/undersampling issues. Yet, privacy is still a major issue behind generating synthetic medical text, where more human assessments are needed to check for the existence of any sensitive information. Despite that, advances in generating synthetic medical text will considerably accelerate the adoption of workflows and pipeline development, discarding the time-consuming legalities of data transfer.

abstract: Liver metastasis is a lethal manifestation of diverse malignancies, but its molecular heterogeneity is not readily captured by routine histopathology. Proteomic profiling has identified functional states of metastatic lesions, although their histomorphological and tumor microenvironmental correlates remain incompletely understood. Here, we developed AI-HistoPS, a computational pathology framework for inferring proteomics-informed states from H&E-stained whole slide images. AI-HistoPS integrates pathology foundation model representations with agent-mediated multiple instance learning to capture subtype-associated morphological patterns. Using multicentre cohorts of liver metastases from multiple primary tumor types, we evaluated associations between histomorphology and three proteomic liver metastasis subtypes (LMS1-3). These states were associated with differences in tumor architecture, stromal composition, and immune cell distribution. AI-HistoPS showed subtype discrimination in the discovery cohort and was evaluated across external cohorts, demonstrating the feasibility of histology-derived representations for proteomics-informed stratification across heterogeneous clinical settings. Attention-guided analyses identified tissue regions associated with subtype-related morphological and microenvironmental features. Multiplex immunohistochemistry supported spatial associations between histological patterns and subtype-related protein markers. These findings suggest that routine histopathology may provide a lower-cost approach for approximating proteomics-informed stratification of liver metastases. Further validation in larger, more diverse, prospectively collected cohorts is required before clinical implementation or use in prognostic or treatment-related decision-making.
zh_abstract: 肝转移是多种恶性肿瘤的致死性表现，但其分子异质性难以通过常规组织病理学充分体现。蛋白质组学分析已识别出转移灶的功能状态，然而其组织形态学及肿瘤微环境相关特征仍未被完全阐明。在此，我们开发了 AI-HistoPS，这是一种计算病理学框架，可从 H&E 染色的全切片图像推断蛋白质组学相关状态。AI-HistoPS 将病理基础模型（pathology foundation model）的表征与智能体介导的多示例学习（agent-mediated multiple instance learning）相结合，以捕捉与亚型相关的形态学模式。我们利用来自多种原发肿瘤类型的肝转移多中心队列，评估了组织形态学与三种蛋白质组学肝转移亚型（LMS1-3）之间的关联。这些状态与肿瘤结构、基质组成和免疫细胞分布的差异相关。AI-HistoPS 在发现队列中显示出亚型区分能力，并在外部队列中进行了评估，表明在异质性临床环境中，利用组织学来源的表征进行蛋白质组学相关分层是可行的。基于注意力引导的分析识别出与亚型相关的形态学和微环境特征相关的组织区域。多重免疫组化支持组织学模式与亚型相关蛋白标志物之间存在空间关联。这些发现提示，常规组织病理学可能为近似实现肝转移的蛋白质组学相关分层提供一种成本更低的方法。在临床应用或用于预后及治疗相关决策之前，仍需在更大规模、更具多样性、前瞻性收集的队列中进一步验证。

abstract: [Annals of noninvasive electrocardiology : the official journal of the International Society for Holter and Noninvasive Electrocardiology, Inc] Left ventricular systolic dysfunction (LVSD) is common and treatable but often undiagnosed, especially in early stages with non-specific symptoms. AI applied to standard ECGs offers low-cost screening for low ejection fraction (EF), yet its real-world impact on diagnosis remains unclear. A systematic review and meta-analysis of RCTs assessed AI-ECG screening for low EF in clinical practice. The protocol was registered with PROSPERO (CRD420261287652). Databases (PubMed, Scopus, Cochrane Central, Google Scholar) were searched from inception to January 18, 2026, for RCTs comparing AI-ECG screening to usual care in adults without known heart failure undergoing routine ECGs. The primary outcome was new low EF (≤ 50%) confirmed by echocardiography. Secondary outcomes included echocardiography referral rates, positive predictive value, and cardiology referral rates. Pooled risk ratios (RR) with 95% CIs were calculated using a random-effects model. Three RCTs were included (two individual and one cluster) with 37,467 participants. After adjusting for clustering, AI-ECG screening significantly improved detection of new low EF diagnoses compared to usual care (RR 1.36, 95% CI 1.12 to 1.64; p = 0.002; I2 = 0%), with a number needed to screen of 204. No significant difference was found in echocardiography referral rates (RR 1.02, 95% CI 0.96 to 1.09; p = 0.55; I2 = 36%). The PPV of the AI tool ranged from approximately 20% to 34% across studies. AI-ECG screening added to routine care improves low EF detection without substantially increasing echocardiography referrals. These findings support AI-ECG for earlier LVSD detection in at-risk populations, though further validation across diverse AI platforms is warranted.

abstract: [European heart journal. Digital health] Paroxysmal atrial fibrillation (AF) is underdiagnosed due to its intermittent and asymptomatic nature. We evaluated whether a deep neural network (DNN) applied to transthoracic echocardiograms (TTEs) acquired in sinus rhythm can discriminate between patients with and without documented AF and identify individuals at increased risk for subsequent AF documentation and adverse outcomes. We retrospectively analysed 85 686 TTE studies (2009-21). A DNN was applied to apical four-chamber and parasternal long-axis videos without Doppler. AF ground truth was based on International Classification of Diseases (ICD) codes, electrocardiogram, Holter, or prior echocardiographic documentation of AF. The dataset was split into training (60%), validation (20%), and an independent test set (20%). In the test cohort, we assessed discrimination performance. Among patients without prior AF, we evaluated associations between model classification and subsequent AF documentation and a composite outcome of all-cause mortality, heart failure hospitalization, or stroke. The test set included 17 121 patients (median age 66 years [interquartile range, IQR 54-75]; 57.6% male), of whom 3449 (20.1%) had prior AF. The model achieved an area under the receiver operating characteristic curve of 0.85, with sensitivity 0.80 and specificity 0.72. At the selected threshold, 6581 patients (38.4%) were classified as model-positive, including 3832 (58.2%) without prior AF. Among patients without prior AF, model-positive classification was associated with subsequent AF documentation [adjusted hazard ratio (HR) 1.64; 95% confidence interval (CI) 1.33-2.04] and with the composite outcome (adjusted HR 1.24; 95% CI 1.13-1.35). Deep learning applied to sinus-rhythm TTE demonstrates discrimination for AF and identifies an imaging-derived signal associated with subsequent AF documentation and adverse outcomes.
zh_abstract: [欧洲心脏杂志·数字健康] 阵发性心房颤动（AF）因其间歇性和无症状的特点而存在诊断不足。我们评估了应用于窦性心律下获取的经胸超声心动图（TTE）的深度神经网络（DNN）能否区分有无AF记录的患者，并识别后续被记录到AF及发生不良结局风险增高的个体。我们回顾性分析了85 686项TTE检查（2009-21年）。DNN应用于不含多普勒的心尖四腔心和胸骨旁长轴视频。AF的真实标签基于国际疾病分类（ICD）编码、心电图、Holter或既往超声心动图对AF的记录。数据集被划分为训练集（60%）、验证集（20%）和独立测试集（20%）。在测试队列中，我们评估了区分性能。在既往无AF的患者中，我们评估了模型分类与后续AF记录以及全因死亡、心力衰竭住院或卒中复合结局之间的关联。测试集包括17 121例患者（中位年龄66岁［四分位距，IQR 54-75］；男性占57.6%），其中3449例（20.1%）既往有AF。模型的受试者工作特征曲线下面积为0.85，敏感性0.80，特异性0.72。在所选阈值下，6581例患者（38.4%）被分类为模型阳性，其中3832例（58.2%）既往无AF。在既往无AF的患者中，模型阳性分类与后续AF记录相关［校正风险比（HR）1.64；95%置信区间（CI）1.33-2.04］，也与复合结局相关（校正HR 1.24；95% CI 1.13-1.35）。应用于窦性心律TTE的深度学习显示出对AF的区分能力，并识别出一种与后续AF记录及不良结局相关的影像来源信号。

title: Americans' views about artificial intelligence in healthcare: 2022-2026.
zh_title: 2022-2026年美国民众对医疗AI的看法
summary: 汇总16项美国成人全国调查，发现超四成因无法获得或负担不起医疗而用AI查询健康问题，且对AI的期望与信任存在落差。
key_points: 数据来自Roper iPoll的16项全国调查
四成以上使用者部分因无法获得或负担医疗
州级立法侧重监督、准确性与隐私
reason: 多项全国调查汇总，涉及公平与治理，属值得一看档
abstract: [Health affairs scholar] The healthcare industry is quickly adopting artificial intelligence (AI). Understanding Americans' views is essential in shaping how these tools are developed and implemented. The data presented here were derived from 16 national surveys of US adults extracted from the Roper Center iPoll database (January 1, 2022-June 24, 2026). This analysis reveals a significant equity issue: more than 4 in 10 Americans using AI for a health question did so, in part, because they could not access or afford care. It also reveals a gap between what Americans believe AI can do for the healthcare system and their trust in it for their care. Public concerns about AI are leading to legislative action at the state level, but this activity primarily focuses on oversight, accuracy, and privacy, not on the access gap driving AI use for many Americans.
zh_abstract: [Health Affairs Scholar] 医疗行业正在迅速采用人工智能（AI）。了解美国人的看法对于塑造这些工具的开发和实施至关重要。此处呈现的数据来自Roper Center iPoll数据库中提取的16项针对美国成年人的全国性调查（2022年1月1日至2026年6月24日）。该分析揭示了一个显著的公平性问题：在使用AI咨询健康问题的美国人中，超过十分之四的人这样做在一定程度上是因为他们无法获得或负担不起医疗服务。分析还显示，美国人对AI能为医疗体系做什么的看法与他们在自身医疗中对AI的信任之间存在差距。公众对AI的担忧正促使各州采取立法行动，但这些行动主要集中于监督、准确性和隐私，而非推动许多美国人使用AI的可及性差距。

title: Interpretable Drug-Target Prediction via Geometric Alignment: A Linear Alternative to Deep Architectural Complexity.
zh_title: 几何流形对齐的可解释药物-靶点预测
summary: 提出线性的多视图流形方法MVLM，将ChemBERTa与ESM-2嵌入对齐到共享空间，用于激酶抑制剂的药物-靶点预测。
key_points: 在47万余条高置信相互作用上预训练
在KIBA上报告AUROC为0.936
以线性方法替代复杂深度架构
reason: 有新意的方法与较大预训练集，但摘要未见外部验证，属值得一看档
abstract: [Molecular informatics] Designing selective kinase inhibitors is a multiobjective optimization problem constrained by the structural conservation of the human kinome, along with the lack of high-quality interaction data. Traditional deep learning methods often train complex neural networks directly on small datasets and fail to generalize to new chemical scaffolds. To this end, we present Geometric Manifold Alignment, a novel linear approach that shifts away from architectural complexity. We introduce Multi-View Linear Manifold (MVLM), which aligns the latent spaces of ChemBERTa (small molecules) and ESM-2 (protein sequences) into a shared geometric interaction space. We pretrain MVLM on the Universal Foundation Set of 473 923 high-confidence interactions, where binding affinity is represented as geometric proximity between drug and target embeddings. Achieving an AUROC of 0.936 on KIBA and 0.928 on Davis, MVLM establishes the new state-of-the-art on industry-standard benchmarks, outperforming existing methods (p < 0.001). In this work, interpretability is geometric where interaction scores are cosine similarities in a shared manifold, and the learned structure recovers kinase phylogenetic relationships without supervision. We also demonstrate the model's utility as a transparent discovery engine by retrieving known clinical targets of FDA-approved drugs. Our findings suggest that aligning pretrained chemical and biological representations provides a scalable and interpretable approach to advancing computational drug discovery.
zh_abstract: [分子信息学] 设计选择性激酶抑制剂是一个多目标优化问题，受限于人类激酶组的结构保守性以及高质量相互作用数据的缺乏。传统深度学习方法常直接在小数据集上训练复杂神经网络，难以泛化到新的化学骨架。为此，我们提出几何流形对齐（Geometric Manifold Alignment），这是一种摒弃架构复杂性的新型线性方法。我们引入多视图线性流形（Multi-View Linear Manifold，MVLM），将ChemBERTa（小分子）和ESM-2（蛋白质序列）的潜在空间对齐到共享的几何相互作用空间中。我们在包含473 923条高置信度相互作用的通用基础集（Universal Foundation Set）上预训练MVLM，其中结合亲和力以药物与靶标嵌入之间的几何邻近度表示。MVLM在KIBA上AUROC达0.936，在Davis上达0.928，在行业标准基准上确立了新的最先进水平，优于现有方法（p < 0.001）。在本研究中，可解释性体现为几何层面：相互作用得分是共享流形中的余弦相似度，且所学结构在无监督条件下恢复了激酶的系统发育关系。我们还通过检索FDA批准药物的已知临床靶标，展示了该模型作为透明的发现引擎的实用性。我们的结果表明，对齐预训练的化学与生物学表示为推进计算药物发现提供了一种可扩展且可解释的途径。

title: Single-cell perturbation prediction near experimental reproducibility with GENESIS
zh_title: GENESIS：接近实验重复性的单细胞扰动预测
summary: 预印本提出基于能量得分的生成框架GENESIS，由实验条件协变量预测单细胞响应分布，并在Tahoe-100M和PBMC细胞因子图谱上优于现有生成方法。
key_points: 轻量神经网络，采用能量得分训练
提出相对实验重复性的评估框架
在Tahoe-100M与PBMC图谱上评测
reason: 新方法有大规模图谱基线对比，但为预印本，值得一看档
abstract: Single-cell perturbation atlases now measure cellular responses across millions of cells, but the number of possible combinations of biological contexts, perturbations, doses and other experimental variables make exhaustive measurements infeasible. Here, we present GENESIS (Generative ENErgy-based Single-cell Intervention Simulator), a generative framework that predicts single-cell response distributions directly from the covariates defining an experimental condition. GENESIS uses a lightweight neural network trained with the energy score, a strictly proper scoring rule for distributions. We introduce an experiment-calibrated evaluation framework in which prediction error is interpreted relative to the reproducibility of repeated measurements of the same condition. Across the Tahoe-100M small-molecule atlas and a large PBMC cytokine atlas, GENESIS significantly outperforms existing generative models and statistical baselines and approaches experimental reproducibility on independently repeated conditions. Importantly, GENESIS remains accurate when trained on only a fraction of the available experimental conditions or cells, and generated profiles recover experimentally observed context-dependent transcriptional programs. At comparable training-cell budgets, GENESIS achieves more accurate predictions when measurements span more experimental conditions rather than profiling fewer conditions more deeply. Together, these findings suggest a complementary strategy for perturbation studies: broader, lower-depth measurements can expand experimental coverage, while GENESIS augments sparsely sampled populations and predicts responses in unmeasured conditions.
zh_abstract: 单细胞扰动图谱目前已能测量数百万个细胞的细胞反应，但生物学背景、扰动、剂量及其他实验变量的可能组合数量之多，使得穷尽式测量不可行。在此，我们提出 GENESIS（Generative ENErgy-based Single-cell Intervention Simulator，基于能量的生成式单细胞干预模拟器），这是一个直接根据定义实验条件的协变量预测单细胞反应分布的生成框架。GENESIS 使用一个轻量级神经网络，并以能量得分（energy score，一种针对分布的严格适当评分规则）进行训练。我们引入了一种经实验校准的评估框架，其中预测误差是相对于同一条件重复测量的可重复性来解释的。在 Tahoe-100M 小分子图谱和一个大型 PBMC 细胞因子图谱中，GENESIS 显著优于现有的生成模型和统计基线，并在独立重复的条件上接近实验可重复性。重要的是，即使仅使用一部分可用实验条件或细胞进行训练，GENESIS 仍保持准确，且生成的表达谱能够还原实验中观察到的依赖于背景的转录程序。在训练细胞预算相当的情况下，当测量覆盖更多实验条件而非对较少条件进行更深入的检测时，GENESIS 的预测更为准确。总之，这些发现提示了扰动研究的一种互补策略：范围更广、深度较低的测量可以扩大实验覆盖面，而 GENESIS 则可扩充采样稀疏的群体，并预测未测量条件下的反应。

title: CAMEL: Cross-Architecture Masked Embedding Learning for Ultra-Lightweight Retinal Foundation Models
zh_title: CAMEL：面向超轻量视网膜基础模型的跨架构掩码嵌入学习
summary: 针对RETFound等视网膜基础模型计算开销大、难以临床部署的问题，提出跨架构掩码嵌入学习构建超轻量模型。
key_points: 关注视网膜基础模型的临床部署瓶颈
方法为跨架构掩码嵌入学习
目标是在硬件受限场景保持性能
reason: 眼科基础模型轻量化，贴合读者偏好，但摘要无具体结果，预印本
abstract: Recent progress in deep learning has substantially advanced automated grading of ophthalmologic pathologies, supported by large annotated datasets and improved representation learning. However, a significant gap remains between state-of-the-art performance and clinical scalability. In particular, foundation models have reshaped image-based medical screening and diagnosis. These large-scale architectures trained on extensive datasets learn rich, generalizable feature representations that can be adapted to a wide range of downstream tasks. In ophthalmology, RETFound, one of the most relevant foundation models for retinal images, performs strongly across classification, segmentation, and risk prediction tasks. Despite their effectiveness, foundation models are often computationally prohibitive, hindering their deployment in real-world clinical environments where hardware constraints and latency are critical. To bridge this gap, we introduce CAMEL (Cross-Architecture Masked Embedding Learning), a novel cross-architecture distillation framework that uses an asymmetric masking strategy during embedding learning to effectively transfer knowledge from massive teacher foundation models to compact, lightweight student models. Our experimental evaluation across four datasets shows that CAMEL preserves accuracy while drastically reducing computational complexity, enabling lightweight yet highly accurate models suitable for resource-limited clinical settings.
zh_abstract: 深度学习的最新进展在大型标注数据集和表征学习改进的支持下，显著推动了眼科病变的自动分级。然而，最先进性能与临床可扩展性之间仍存在显著差距。特别是，基础模型已重塑了基于图像的医学筛查和诊断。这些在海量数据集上训练的大规模架构可学习丰富且可泛化的特征表征，能够适配广泛的下游任务。在眼科领域，RETFound是视网膜图像最相关的基础模型之一，在分类、分割和风险预测任务中表现出色。尽管效果良好，基础模型的计算成本往往过高，阻碍了其在硬件受限且对延迟要求严格的真实临床环境中的部署。为弥合这一差距，我们提出CAMEL（Cross-Architecture Masked Embedding Learning，跨架构掩码嵌入学习），这是一种新颖的跨架构蒸馏框架，在嵌入学习过程中采用非对称掩码策略，将知识从大型教师基础模型有效迁移至紧凑、轻量的学生模型。我们在四个数据集上的实验评估表明，CAMEL在保持准确性的同时大幅降低了计算复杂度，使得轻量而高度准确的模型适用于资源受限的临床环境。

title: BABA-Bench: Evaluating Long-Horizon Patient-Advocacy Agents
zh_title: BABA-Bench：评测长程患者倡导智能体
summary: 构建含47个交互世界的基准，源自真实去标识患者倡导案例，评测14个前沿模型共1974次运行，检查结果与流程合规（预印本）。
key_points: 47个世界取自专家审核的真实案例
引擎实时检查授权、证据与禁止行为
智能体常经无效流程达到正确结果
reason: 新的医疗智能体基准，评测流程合规，预印本档内上调
abstract: An LLM agent that helps a patient get care must do two things. It must reach the correct outcome, and it must follow the necessary procedure. For example, the agent must get the patient's permission before it shares the patient's records. We introduce BABA-Bench, a benchmark of 47 interactive worlds. We built each world from a de-identified, real patient advocacy case that expert advocates reviewed. In each world, the agent must find hidden information and coordinate insurers, clinics, suppliers, pharmacies, and community organizations. The engine checks each action at the time the agent does it. It checks if the agent has permission, if the agent has evidence for the action, and if the action is prohibited. We evaluated 14 frontier models with three runs on each world, for a total of 1,974 runs. Agents often reached the correct outcome by an invalid route. Of the 921 runs that reached all required outcomes, 254 (28%) did not follow the necessary procedure. Claude Opus 5 reached all required outcomes in 81.6% of its runs, but only 52.5% of its runs passed all checks. When we gave two models a verified route, their pass rates increased from 29.8% to 91.5% and from 44.0% to 97.2%. For these models, the main problem is to find a route, not to execute it.

title: MEMIG: Self-evolving Memory Construction for Antibody Optimization
zh_title: MEMIG：用于抗体优化的自进化记忆构建
summary: 提出可索引、定量、结构化的智能体记忆框架，用于生物分子优化中保存实验测量经验，而非自由文本改写（预印本）。
key_points: 指出文本记忆不适合以测量值为经验的科学优化
记忆需可索引、定量、结构化
面向抗体优化的LLM智能体
reason: 科学发现智能体新方法，摘要无充分结果，预印本档内上调
abstract: Memory has become central to self-evolving LLM agents, which store and retrieve experience from past rollouts to guide future decisions. Existing systems represent this experience as free-form natural language and maintain it by rewriting, which fits tasks whose experience is narratable. However, in scientific discovery and optimization, experience is often a quantity measured by an oracle under a specific context. Rewriting it as text leaves no index for where a record should be, replaces a measurement with a description, and cannot express how interventions interact. To address this, we argue that agent memory for biomolecule optimization should instead be indexable, quantitative, and structured, and we introduce MEMIG. This memory construction framework realizes these three properties. In detail, MEMIG addresses each insight with a domain-grounded identifier and accumulates the quantitative effect measured by a property oracle, so that updates remain local and retrieval becomes an exact lookup. Next, MEMIG connects insights whose interventions are applied together and measures their epistasis by decomposing each evaluated set. Our results show that MEMIG improves performance in most settings across in silico antibody optimization tasks.

title: Coupled or Independent? Fault Coupling in Agentic Medical Vision Systems
zh_title: 智能体医学视觉系统中的故障耦合：独立还是耦合？
summary: 在皮肤科视觉语言智能体中检验工具与推理通道共享视觉故障时的安全性，PAD-UFES-20上排版注入导致检索被劫持（预印本）。
key_points: 定义单通道错误与联合错误的耦合分类
排版注入产生可检测的检索捕获，物理损坏不会
裁剪优先检索联合错误一致率达55%
reason: 皮肤科VLM智能体安全性分析，新颖但为预印本
abstract: Vision-language agents equipped with tools expose intermediate outputs for inspection and comparison with the model's reasoning, which may offer safety benefits over single-shot models. This paper tests that potential benefit when the sensor reading itself is untrusted, so that the tool and reasoning channels share a common visual fault. We consider a dermatology agent based on segmentation, contrastive retrieval, and an iterative vision-language reasoner and define a coupling taxonomy that distinguishes single-channel errors from joint errors that agree or disagree. On PAD-UFES-20, we show that typographic injection produces detectable directional retrieval capture, whereas physical corruption does not. Crop-first retrieval preserves the payload at a readable scale and produces 55% joint wrong agreement across all cases (71% of faulty cases); full-image retrieval produces 35% (43%). Under a binary decision, if both channels are wrong, their predictions must agree, so hard-label channel comparison cannot detect joint failures, limiting disagreement recall to 0.29 (crop-first) versus 0.57 (full-image). The direction of the order effect is reproduced on the independent HIBA test set.

title: Sparse Autoencoders for Expert-Assisted Interpretation of Histopathology Foundation Model Embeddings
zh_title: 用稀疏自编码器辅助专家解读病理基础模型嵌入
summary: 在NCT-CRC嵌入上训练稀疏自编码器，将CONCH及UNI2-h等病理基础模型嵌入分解为可供专家解读的稀疏特征（预印本）。
key_points: 训练vanilla与Batch-TopK两类SAE
以CONCH为主、UNI2-h作稳健性评估
从重构、稀疏性、标签富集等角度表征
reason: 病理基础模型可解释性，数据集较单一，预印本档内上调
abstract: Histopathology foundation models learn rich embedding representations, but their internal structure remains difficult to inspect. Concept-level interpretability is particularly relevant in computational pathology because pathologists reason through recurring morphological and tissue-level patterns, including tissue architecture, cellular morphology, staining variation, and artifacts. In this work, we investigate whether sparse autoencoders (SAEs) can decompose embeddings from histopathology foundation models into sparse latent features suitable for expert-assisted interpretation. We train vanilla and Batch-TopK SAE variants on NCT-CRC embeddings, using CONCH as the primary foundation model and UNI2-h as an additional robustness evaluation, and characterize the resulting latent features through reconstruction fidelity, sparsity, coherence, label enrichment, and downstream class-signal preservation. The learned sparse representations preserve most downstream tissue-class information, and their latent features retrieve more coherent and label-concentrated patch groups than raw embedding dimensions or PCA components. Discussions with pathology experts further motivated a WSI-level latent visualization workflow that places feature activations into larger tissue context. Overall, the additional UNI2-h evaluation suggests that the observed behavior is not specific to CONCH, supporting the use of sparse autoencoders for expert-assisted analysis of histopathology foundation-model embeddings, while emphasizing that latent features should be treated as candidate concepts requiring pathological assessment rather than automatically validated histopathological concepts.
zh_abstract: 组织病理学基础模型可学习丰富的嵌入表示，但其内部结构仍难以检视。概念层面的可解释性在计算病理学中尤为重要，因为病理医师是通过反复出现的形态学和组织层面的模式进行推理的，这些模式包括组织结构、细胞形态、染色差异和伪影。在本研究中，我们探讨稀疏自编码器（sparse autoencoders，SAEs）能否将组织病理学基础模型的嵌入分解为适合专家辅助解释的稀疏潜在特征。我们在 NCT-CRC 嵌入上训练了普通（vanilla）和 Batch-TopK 两种 SAE 变体，以 CONCH 作为主要基础模型，并以 UNI2-h 作为额外的稳健性评估，通过重建保真度、稀疏性、一致性、标签富集度以及下游类别信号保留情况对所得潜在特征进行表征。所学得的稀疏表示保留了大部分下游组织类别信息，并且其潜在特征所检索到的图像块组比原始嵌入维度或 PCA 成分更加一致，且更集中于特定标签。与病理专家的讨论进一步推动了一种全切片图像（WSI）层面的潜在特征可视化流程，可将特征激活置于更大的组织背景中。总体而言，额外的 UNI2-h 评估表明，所观察到的行为并非 CONCH 所特有，支持将稀疏自编码器用于组织病理学基础模型嵌入的专家辅助分析，同时强调潜在特征应被视为需要病理学评估的候选概念，而不是自动得到验证的组织病理学概念。

title: PathoJev: Efficient Pathology Decisions from Shared Visual Context
zh_title: PathoJev：基于共享视觉上下文的高效病理决策
summary: 病理模型对每张切片编码一次，批量评估多个问题并直接预测答案概率；9B/27B在三个WSI基准上平均准确率77.2%/78.1%，高于SlideChat（预印本）。
key_points: 切片只编码一次，问题后缀批量评估
9B与27B平均准确率77.2%和78.1%
分别超过SlideChat 5.4与6.3个百分点
reason: 病理多模态大模型，有基线对比，但证据为预印本
abstract: Pathology workflows require multiple visual judgments about the same slide, from identifying tumor type to assessing grade and invasion. Generating and parsing a separate textual response for each structured question adds latency between visual evidence and usable decisions. Building on the System One paradigm, we introduce PathoJev, a pathology model that directly predicts answer probabilities for whole-slide and region-level assessment. PathoJev encodes each slide once and evaluates independent question suffixes in batches over the shared visual context. Reusing the hybrid backbone's recurrent states further limits the computation that grows with slide-context length for each additional question. Across three whole-slide benchmarks, the 9B and 27B models achieve mean accuracies of 77.2% and 78.1%, exceeding SlideChat by 5.4 and 6.3 percentage points. Both scales also maintain competitive accuracy on five ROI benchmarks. On WSI-Bench, the 9B model runs 9.1x faster than SlideChat. Shared context accelerates eight-question workloads by 6.9x and 5.9x over separate prefix encoding, rising to 11.2x and 8.9x for 64 questions. These results provide a reusable probabilistic interface for combining multiple visual judgments in whole-slide and local tissue assessment. Code: https://github.com/ChyaZhang/PathoJev.
zh_abstract: 病理工作流程需要对同一张玻片作出多项视觉判断，从识别肿瘤类型到评估分级和浸润。为每个结构化问题分别生成并解析文本回答，会在视觉证据与可用决策之间增加延迟。基于 System One 范式，我们提出 PathoJev，这是一种可直接预测全切片及区域层面评估答案概率的病理模型。PathoJev 对每张玻片仅编码一次，并在共享的视觉上下文上以批处理方式评估相互独立的问题后缀。复用混合骨干网络的循环状态，进一步限制了每增加一个问题时随切片上下文长度增长的计算量。在三个全切片基准上，9B 和 27B 模型的平均准确率分别为 77.2% 和 78.1%，比 SlideChat 高 5.4 和 6.3 个百分点。两种规模的模型在五个 ROI 基准上也保持了具有竞争力的准确率。在 WSI-Bench 上，9B 模型的运行速度比 SlideChat 快 9.1 倍。共享上下文使八个问题的工作负载相比分别进行前缀编码加速 6.9 倍和 5.9 倍，在 64 个问题时升至 11.2 倍和 8.9 倍。这些结果为在全切片和局部组织评估中整合多项视觉判断提供了可复用的概率接口。代码：https://github.com/ChyaZhang/PathoJev。

title: Bioactivity foundation model for hit identification and hit-to-lead optimization from sequence data
zh_title: 面向苗头化合物识别与先导优化的序列生物活性基础模型
summary: PSICHIC+基于约8200万条蛋白-配体记录，以分布式目标预测序列与SMILES的结合亲和力，零样本虚拟筛选表现具竞争力。

abstract: Learning from large-scale bioactivity archives is complicated by heterogeneous assay readouts and differences in data reliability. Here we show that a model that predicts probability distributions over binding affinities from sequence data opens model training to vast and diverse troves of heterogeneous bioactivity data. We develop PSICHIC+, a bioactivity foundation model trained on approximately 82 million protein-ligand records using a distributional objective that preserves quantitative resolution while incorporating variation in data reliability. Given a protein sequence and ligand SMILES, PSICHIC+ predicts binding affinity in milliseconds. In zero-shot virtual-screening benchmarks without target-specific training data, it improves enrichment over regression- and classification-based approaches and performs competitively with leading structure-based methods. In lab-in-the-loop campaigns, distribution-guided acquisition improves recovery of high-activity compounds under fixed screening budgets. Combining PSICHIC+ with Boltz-2 improves hit-to-lead affinity prediction over Boltz-2 alone, with mean correlation approaching that of FEP+ on the evaluated benchmarks, without requiring high-resolution protein structures. These results support distributional learning as a scalable approach to using heterogeneous bioactivity data for hit identification and hit-to-lead optimization.
zh_abstract: 从大规模生物活性数据库中学习,受到检测读数异质性以及数据可靠性差异的困扰。本文表明,一种可根据序列数据预测结合亲和力概率分布的模型,使模型训练能够利用海量且多样的异质生物活性数据。我们开发了PSICHIC+,这是一种生物活性基础模型,基于约8200万条蛋白-配体记录,采用分布式目标函数进行训练,该目标函数在保留定量分辨率的同时纳入了数据可靠性的差异。给定蛋白质序列和配体SMILES,PSICHIC+可在毫秒内预测结合亲和力。在无靶点特异性训练数据的零样本虚拟筛选基准测试中,其富集效果优于基于回归和分类的方法,并与领先的基于结构的方法表现相当。在实验闭环(lab-in-the-loop)研究中,在固定筛选预算下,分布引导的采集策略提高了高活性化合物的回收率。将PSICHIC+与Boltz-2联合使用,相比单独使用Boltz-2可改善从苗头化合物到先导化合物阶段的亲和力预测,在所评估的基准上平均相关性接近FEP+,且无需高分辨率蛋白质结构。这些结果支持将分布式学习作为一种可扩展的方法,用于利用异质生物活性数据进行苗头化合物识别和从苗头到先导的优化。

title: MRI-based deep learning model for prediction of Ki-67 expression level in intrahepatic cholangiocarcinoma.
zh_title: 基于MRI的深度学习预测肝内胆管癌Ki-67表达水平
summary: 回顾性研究（2020–2024年），用3D-ResNet10提取MRI特征，并与临床特征融合，术前无创预测iCCA的Ki-67高低表达。

abstract: [Abdominal radiology (New York)] Ki-67 expression is a valuable prognostic indicator in intrahepatic cholangiocarcinoma (iCCA). This study aimed to develop a non-invasive Deep learning (DL) model based on magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) and clinical data to predict Ki-67 expression preoperatively. Patients with iCCA between January 2020 and January 2024 were retrospectively reviewed. Based on immunohistochemistry, patients were classified into high-expression group (Ki-67 > 50%) and low-expression group (Ki-67 ≤ 50%). After image acquisition, tumor segmentation, and preprocessing, a 3D-ResNet10 network was utilized for MRI feature extraction. A feed-forward neural network (FFN) was used for clinical feature extraction. Subsequently, the extracted image and clinical features were fused and fed into a lightweight classifier to perform Ki-67 level prediction. The performance of the DL models was evaluated via 5-fold cross-validation using accuracy, precision, sensitivity, specificity, F1-score, and the area under the curve (AUC). A total of 117 patients were ultimately included (30 cases in the high-expression group and 87 cases in the low-expression group). The model based solely on clinical variables demonstrated limited predictive efficacy (mean AUC: 53.18 ± 14.60%). The model utilizing MRI features alone exhibited high specificity (86.14 ± 10.25%) but modest sensitivity. In contrast, the fused DL model significantly outperformed both individual models, attaining a mean AUC of 84.24 ± 8.82%, an accuracy of 87.17 ± 5.95%, a specificity of 93.07 ± 9.35%, and a markedly improved sensitivity of 70.00 ± 19.44%, yielding a robust F1-score of 73.42 ± 12.28%. We developed and validated a non-invasive DL model integrating contrast-enhanced MRI and clinical parameters that accurately predicts Ki-67 expression in iCCA, demonstrating superior diagnostic performance.
zh_abstract: [腹部放射学（纽约）] Ki-67表达是肝内胆管癌（iCCA）的一项有价值的预后指标。本研究旨在基于磁共振成像（MRI）和临床数据，建立一种无创的深度学习（DL）模型，用于术前预测Ki-67表达。我们回顾性分析了2020年1月至2024年1月期间的iCCA患者。根据免疫组化结果，将患者分为高表达组（Ki-67 > 50%）和低表达组（Ki-67 ≤ 50%）。在完成图像采集、肿瘤分割和预处理后，采用3D-ResNet10网络提取MRI特征，采用前馈神经网络（FFN）提取临床特征。随后，将提取的影像特征与临床特征融合，并输入轻量级分类器以预测Ki-67水平。通过5折交叉验证，采用准确率、精确率、敏感性、特异性、F1分数和曲线下面积（AUC）评估DL模型的性能。最终共纳入117例患者（高表达组30例，低表达组87例）。仅基于临床变量的模型预测效能有限（平均AUC：53.18 ± 14.60%）。仅利用MRI特征的模型表现出较高的特异性（86.14 ± 10.25%），但敏感性一般。相比之下，融合DL模型显著优于上述两个单一模型，平均AUC为84.24 ± 8.82%，准确率为87.17 ± 5.95%，特异性为93.07 ± 9.35%，敏感性明显提高至70.00 ± 19.44%，F1分数为73.42 ± 12.28%，表现稳健。我们建立并验证了一种整合增强MRI和临床参数的无创DL模型，可准确预测iCCA中的Ki-67表达，显示出优越的诊断性能。

title: Artificial intelligence in axial spondyloarthritis imaging: a review of current evidence.
zh_title: 轴性脊柱关节炎影像中的AI：现有证据综述

abstract: [Current opinion in immunology] The diagnosis of axial spondyloarthritis (axSpA) remains challenging and is frequently delayed. Imaging is central to diagnosis, but relevant inflammatory and structural abnormalities may be subtle, heterogeneous, or overlap with findings related to mechanical stress, anatomical variation, and degeneration. Artificial intelligence (AI), particularly deep learning, is therefore being investigated to support image interpretation, lesion detection, quantification, and standardized assessment. We synthesize evidence from 12 studies applying convolutional neural networks and related architectures to magnetic resonance imaging and radiographs, automate imaging scores, and combine imaging-derived information with clinical variables. Several models achieved performance comparable to experienced human readers, including during external validation. However, performance may decline in heterogeneous real-world populations for study-specific reasons not explained solely by scanner or protocol differences. No AI tool currently has regulatory clearance for autonomous use in axSpA, and applications remain largely confined to research and clinical trials.
zh_abstract: [免疫学当前观点] 轴向脊柱关节炎（axSpA）的诊断仍具挑战性，且常被延误。影像学在诊断中处于核心地位，但相关的炎症性和结构性异常可能细微、异质，或与机械应力、解剖变异及退行性改变相关的表现重叠。因此，人工智能（AI），尤其是深度学习，正被用于辅助影像判读、病灶检测、定量及标准化评估。我们综合了12项研究的证据，这些研究将卷积神经网络及相关架构应用于磁共振成像和X线片，实现影像评分的自动化，并将影像来源信息与临床变量相结合。多个模型的表现可与经验丰富的人类读片者相当，包括在外部验证中。然而，在异质性的真实世界人群中，模型性能可能下降，其原因具有研究特异性，并非仅由扫描仪或扫描方案差异所能解释。目前尚无AI工具获得监管机构批准用于axSpA的自主应用，其应用仍主要局限于研究和临床试验。

title: AI-Enabled Animal Behavior Analysis for Translational Pharmacology and Therapeutic Discovery.
zh_title: AI赋能动物行为分析：转化药理与治疗发现
summary: 综述目标检测、无标记姿态估计、无监督行为分割、基础模型与自主分析智能体如何重塑临床前行为表型分析。

abstract: [Biomolecules & therapeutics] Animal behavior is a critical endpoint in preclinical pharmacology, toxicology, and therapeutic discovery, yet conventional behavioral scoring remains labor-intensive, low-dimensional, and difficult to reproduce across laboratories. Artificial intelligence (AI) can now quantify behavior from video with greater spatial, temporal, and phenotypic resolution. This review summarizes how object detection, markerless pose estimation, unsupervised behavioral segmentation, foundation models, and autonomous analysis agents are reshaping behavioral phenotyping. General-purpose object detectors rapidly localize and track animals, whereas open-source pose-estimation tools extend measurement beyond centroid tracking to body-part trajectories and fine motor patterns; paired with supervised classifiers, they have matched human scoring and exceeded some commercial systems. Technical accuracy alone does not establish behavioral construct validity or pharmacological validity. Unsupervised methods such as Motion Sequencing represent drug responses and disease-model phenotypes as structured changes in behavioral states rather than only as predefined endpoints, providing high-dimensional fingerprints of pharmacological action. Segmentation and tracking foundation models may reduce annotation burden but require validation across species, strain, sex, apparatus, and paradigm. AI agents may assist with literature review, code generation, analysis auditing, and figure production but must remain within transparent, human-supervised workflows. In behavioral pharmacology, pose estimation is established as a measurement method and emerging as a drug-effect endpoint, supervised classification and unsupervised segmentation are emerging, and foundation models and agents remain prospective. AI-enabled behavioral analysis can become a reproducible phenotyping layer for drug discovery and toxicology if researchers adopt open pipelines, rigorous validation, and reporting standards, rather than replacing one opaque measurement system with another.
zh_abstract: [生物分子与治疗学] 动物行为是临床前药理学、毒理学和治疗学研发中的关键终点，但传统的行为评分仍然费时费力、维度低，且难以在不同实验室间重现。人工智能（AI）现已能够以更高的空间、时间和表型分辨率从视频中量化行为。本综述总结了目标检测、无标记姿态估计、无监督行为分割、基础模型和自主分析智能体如何重塑行为表型分析。通用目标检测器可快速定位并追踪动物，而开源姿态估计工具则将测量从质心追踪扩展到身体部位轨迹和精细运动模式；与监督分类器配合使用时，它们已达到人工评分水平，并超过了部分商业系统。仅有技术上的准确性并不能确立行为结构效度或药理学效度。诸如运动序列分析（Motion Sequencing）等无监督方法，将药物反应和疾病模型表型表示为行为状态的结构化变化，而不仅仅是预先定义的终点，从而提供药理作用的高维特征谱。分割与追踪基础模型可能减轻标注负担，但需要在不同物种、品系、性别、实验装置和范式中进行验证。AI智能体可协助文献综述、代码生成、分析审核和图表制作，但必须处于透明、有人监督的工作流程之内。在行为药理学中，姿态估计已确立为一种测量方法，并正在成为药物效应终点；监督分类和无监督分割正在兴起，而基础模型和智能体仍属前瞻性。如果研究者采用开放的流程、严格的验证和报告标准，而不是以一种不透明的测量系统取代另一种，AI赋能的行为分析就能成为药物研发和毒理学中可重复的表型分析层。

title: Translational maturity of artificial intelligence-enabled electrocardiography varies across cardiovascular diseases.
zh_title: AI心电图在不同心血管疾病中的转化成熟度参差不齐
summary: 批判性叙述综述，评估AI-ECG在多种心血管疾病中的转化成熟度，纳入77篇文献，指出高回顾性判别力未必转化为临床获益。

abstract: [Frontiers in cardiovascular medicine] Electrocardiography is a widely available and low-cost cardiovascular test, and artificial intelligence-enabled electrocardiography (AI-ECG) can identify latent electrical phenotypes beyond conventional interpretation. However, high retrospective discrimination does not necessarily translate into clinically reliable or actionable benefit. This critical narrative review evaluates the translational maturity of AI-ECG across arrhythmias, acute myocardial infarction, heart failure, valvular heart disease, hypertrophic cardiomyopathy, and cardiac amyloidosis. PubMed, IEEE Xplore, and Web of Science were searched from January 1, 2022, through July 10, 2026, with earlier landmark studies added by backward citation tracking. Seventy-seven publications informed the review. Evidence was appraised using five clinically oriented criteria: intended use, reference-standard reliability, external validation and transportability, clinical actionability, and effects on workflow or patient outcomes. AI-ECG has progressed furthest in ST-segment elevation myocardial infarction triage and reduced-left-ventricular-ejection-fraction screening, where prospective or randomized studies have demonstrated workflow or diagnostic-yield benefits, whereas acute myocardial infarction rule-out has reached prospective multicenter diagnostic validation. Hypertrophic cardiomyopathy screening has also advanced through international validation and prospective implementation. By contrast, occlusion myocardial infarction detection, prediction of occult or future atrial fibrillation, valvular heart disease, heart failure with preserved ejection fraction, long-term heart-failure prediction, and cardiac amyloidosis remain primarily validation-stage or risk-enrichment applications. Across domains, broader adoption is constrained by label quality, calibration, transportability, operating-threshold selection, and limited patient-outcome evidence. AI-ECG is therefore best positioned as clinician-supervised decision support linked to explicit downstream testing and care pathways.
zh_abstract: [Frontiers in cardiovascular medicine] 心电图是一种广泛可及且成本低廉的心血管检查，而人工智能心电图（AI-ECG）能够识别常规解读之外的潜在电生理表型。然而，较高的回顾性判别性能并不一定转化为临床上可靠或可付诸行动的获益。本批判性叙述性综述评估了 AI-ECG 在心律失常、急性心肌梗死、心力衰竭、瓣膜性心脏病、肥厚型心肌病和心脏淀粉样变性中的转化成熟度。检索了 PubMed、IEEE Xplore 和 Web of Science，时间范围为 2022 年 1 月 1 日至 2026 年 7 月 10 日，并通过向前追溯引文的方式补充了更早的里程碑式研究。共有 77 篇文献纳入本综述。证据依据五项以临床为导向的标准进行评价：预期用途、参考标准的可靠性、外部验证与可迁移性、临床可操作性，以及对工作流程或患者结局的影响。AI-ECG 在 ST 段抬高型心肌梗死分诊和左心室射血分数降低筛查方面进展最快，前瞻性或随机研究已证实其在工作流程或诊断检出率方面的获益，而急性心肌梗死的排除诊断已达到前瞻性多中心诊断验证阶段。肥厚型心肌病筛查也通过国际验证和前瞻性实施取得进展。相比之下，闭塞性心肌梗死检测、隐匿性或未来心房颤动的预测、瓣膜性心脏病、射血分数保留的心力衰竭、心力衰竭的长期预测以及心脏淀粉样变性，仍主要处于验证阶段或风险富集应用阶段。在各个领域，更广泛的应用受到标签质量、校准、可迁移性、操作阈值选择以及患者结局证据有限的制约。因此，AI-ECG 最适合作为在临床医生监督下、与明确的后续检查和诊疗路径相衔接的决策支持工具。

abstract: [Personalized medicine] High-throughput technologies generate large and complex biological datasets that can challenge conventional methods of analysis and visualization. Artificial intelligence (AI) can support the analysis and integration of these datasets, provide new analytical approaches, and accelerate biological research. However, reliable AI applications depend on high-quality, consistent data. Technical errors, bias, and deficiencies in analytical methods can produce misleading findings and undermine reproducibility. AI-based approaches may help identify errors and improve data quality, but poor-quality or biased datasets, limited reproducibility, and concerns about privacy and ethics remain important barriers to their use in biological research. A literature search was performed in PubMed for papers published between 2015 and 2025. This review summarizes recent advances in AI for biological data analysis, including its main applications and potential benefits. It also discusses methodological, translational, and ethical challenges that may limit implementation. Particular attention is given to data quality and reliability, alongside the responsible use of AI in biological research and its translation to personalized medicine.
zh_abstract: [个体化医学] 高通量技术产生了大量复杂的生物学数据集，这对传统的分析和可视化方法构成挑战。人工智能（AI）可支持这些数据集的分析与整合，提供新的分析方法，并加速生物学研究。然而，可靠的 AI 应用依赖于高质量、一致的数据。技术误差、偏倚以及分析方法的不足可能产生误导性的发现，并损害可重复性。基于 AI 的方法可能有助于识别错误并提高数据质量，但数据集质量差或存在偏倚、可重复性有限，以及对隐私和伦理的担忧，仍是其在生物学研究中应用的重要障碍。本研究在 PubMed 中检索了 2015 年至 2025 年发表的文献。本综述总结了 AI 在生物学数据分析方面的最新进展，包括其主要应用和潜在益处，并讨论了可能限制其实施的方法学、转化和伦理方面的挑战。文中特别关注数据质量与可靠性，以及 AI 在生物学研究中的负责任使用及其向个体化医学的转化。

title: Algorithmic design choices as determinants of health equity: a causal simulation study of healthcare resource allocation
zh_title: 算法设计选择决定健康公平：医疗资源分配的因果模拟研究
summary: 预印本利用 All of Us 的201,216名成人数据，模拟阈值、特征集和训练目标三项设计选择对照护管理资源分配公平性的影响。

abstract: Background. Care management programs increasingly rely on prediction algorithms to decide which patients receive limited healthcare resources. Because these algorithms are typically trained to predict future healthcare utilization or cost, they may systematically underidentify patients whose care-seeking behavior is suppressed by structural barriers. Objective. To evaluate how three modifiable design choices (selection threshold, feature set, and training objective) affect allocation equity in care management targeting. Methods. We constructed an analytical cohort of 201,216 adults from linked electronic health record and participant survey data in the NIH All of Us Research Program (2017-2019). Three prediction models (logistic regression, random forest, and XGBoost) were trained and evaluated under simulation conditions that varied one design choice at a time while holding the others fixed. Equity was assessed using false negative rate (FNR), equal opportunity difference (EOD), and allocation rate conditional on need (an access-independent benchmark based on self-reported general health status). We also applied Oaxaca-Blinder decomposition to identify which predictors contributed most to the Black-White allocation gap. Results. Prior utilization understated self-reported health burden among disadvantaged groups: 33% of Black and 32% of Hispanic participants reported fair or poor health, yet only 22% and 19% were classified as high utilizers. White participants showed the opposite pattern: 25% were classified as high utilizers, while only 19% reported fair or poor general health status. Under baseline design choices, all three models produced similar disparities, with uninsured participants showing the largest gap (EOD: -0.148). Oaxaca-Blinder decomposition identified prior outpatient visits as the dominant contributor to the Black-White gap in predicted allocation, with higher average emergency department utilization among Black participants partially offsetting the effect. Varying the selection threshold had little effect; disparities persisted across all thresholds. Feature set variation produced mixed and group-specific effects; removal of prior outpatient visits achieved near-zero Black-White EOD (0.001, AUC: 0.77), consistent with the Oaxaca-Blinder decomposition finding. title: FateDriver: Weakly supervised dual-view graph learning for transition-specific prioritization of candidate regulators in cellular reprogramming

abstract: Cellular reprogramming supports regenerative medicine, yet the endogenous regulators of a specified source-to-target transition remain incompletely defined. Existing computational methods rank candidate regulators from network topology, trajectory dynamics, or cell-state labels, leaving unused the factors experimentally delivered to induce the transition. We present FateDriver, a weakly supervised dual-view graph neural network that jointly represents cells and genes from single-cell transcriptomes, treats the delivered factors as sparse gene-level labels, and ranks the remaining genes for a specified transition under a positive--unlabeled formulation. Across two OSKM datasets and one GMT dataset, FateDriver ranked first or second among six methods in recovering externally curated reference genes, exceeded a supervision-matched non-graph model despite weaker co-expression with the delivered factors, and achieved the highest recovery of protein targets of pluripotency-inducing chemical cocktails in both OSKM datasets. Holding either the source or the endpoint fixed yielded distinct candidate programs, including a DDX58--interferon axis associated with cells lacking endogenous pluripotency markers. Applying the same framework to candidate source--target pairs prioritized distinct candidate origins for two in vivo partially reprogrammed intestinal populations. FateDriver converts sparse experimental knowledge into transition-specific hypotheses for regulator prioritization from single-cell trajectories.
zh_abstract: 细胞重编程支持再生医学，但针对特定起始细胞到目标细胞转变的内源性调控因子仍未被完全阐明。现有计算方法基于网络拓扑、轨迹动力学或细胞状态标签对候选调控因子进行排序，而未利用实验中为诱导该转变所递送的因子。我们提出 FateDriver，一种弱监督的双视图图神经网络，可从单细胞转录组中联合表征细胞和基因，将所递送的因子视为稀疏的基因水平标签，并在正例-未标注（positive–unlabeled）框架下对特定转变中其余基因进行排序。在两个 OSKM 数据集和一个 GMT 数据集中，FateDriver 在恢复外部整理的参考基因方面，在六种方法中排名第一或第二；尽管与所递送因子的共表达较弱，其表现仍超过监督条件匹配的非图模型；并且在两个 OSKM 数据集中，其对诱导多能性的化学鸡尾酒蛋白靶点的恢复率最高。固定起始细胞或终点之一，可得到不同的候选程序，包括与缺乏内源性多能性标志物的细胞相关的 DDX58–干扰素轴。将同一框架应用于候选的起始–目标细胞对，为两个体内部分重编程的肠道细胞群体优先给出了不同的候选起源。FateDriver 将稀疏的实验知识转化为针对特定转变的假说，用于基于单细胞轨迹的调控因子优先排序。

abstract: RNA foundation models offer a promising route to decoding the relationships between RNA sequence, structure and function, yet how model shapes the acquisition and organization of biological information remains poorly understood. Here we introduce Layer-Interleaved Mamba-Bidirectional Encoder for RNA (LIMBER), a hybrid foundation model integrating bidirectional self-attention with selective state-space modeling, pretrained on 40.5 million non-coding RNA sequences. Through task-specific fine-tuning, LIMBER achieves leading performance on secondary-structure prediction and non-coding RNA classification benchmarks, while demonstrating strong transferability to translation-related tasks and RNA--small-molecule interaction prediction. Beyond model development, we establish a unified, task-agnostic framework to systematically evaluate and interpret the biological knowledge intrinsically acquired by RNA foundation models. This framework validates LIMBER's strong capabilities in recovering RNA structures and predicting mutational effects, while uncovering a hierarchical, task-dependent organization of different biological information across model layers. By further systematically training and evaluating a broad panel of model variants spanning model capacity, training duration and dataset size, we uncover distinct scaling behaviors across structural, evolutionary and functional capabilities. Together, these findings establish LIMBER as a versatile RNA foundation model and provide broader insights into how architectural design, internal representations and scaling shape the learning of RNA sequence-structure-function relationships.
zh_abstract: RNA基础模型为解码RNA序列、结构与功能之间的关系提供了一条有前景的途径，然而模型如何塑造生物学信息的获取与组织方式，仍知之甚少。在此，我们提出 Layer-Interleaved Mamba-Bidirectional Encoder for RNA（LIMBER），这是一种将双向自注意力与选择性状态空间建模相结合的混合基础模型，在4050万条非编码RNA序列上进行了预训练。通过针对特定任务的微调，LIMBER 在二级结构预测和非编码RNA分类基准上取得了领先的性能，同时在翻译相关任务和RNA–小分子相互作用预测上表现出很强的可迁移性。除模型开发之外，我们还建立了一个统一的、与任务无关的框架，用于系统评估和解读RNA基础模型内在获得的生物学知识。该框架验证了 LIMBER 在还原RNA结构和预测突变效应方面的强大能力，同时揭示了不同生物学信息在模型各层之间呈现出层级性、依赖于任务的组织方式。通过进一步系统地训练和评估涵盖模型容量、训练时长和数据集规模的一系列模型变体，我们发现结构、进化和功能能力具有各不相同的缩放行为。总之，这些发现确立了 LIMBER 作为一种多功能RNA基础模型，并为架构设计、内部表征和缩放如何塑造RNA序列–结构–功能关系的学习提供了更广泛的见解。

summary: 按PRISMA 2020对2020年1月至2026年6月的研究进行综述，检索到1,078条记录，涵盖方法、模态、数据集与验证实践。

abstract: [Frontiers in human neuroscience] Brain imaging is central to the structural, functional, metabolic, and neurophysiological characterization of neurological disease, yet interpretation remains constrained by heterogeneity in acquisition, annotation, expertise, and clinical context. This systematic literature review evaluates recent artificial intelligence approaches for brain imaging and computer-aided diagnosis, with emphasis on methods, modalities, neurological diseases, diagnostic tasks, datasets, validation practices, and translational limitations. The review followed PRISMA 2020 and covered peer-reviewed English-language studies published from January 2020 through June 2026. Eight information sources were searched using database-specific terms for artificial intelligence, neuroimaging, neurological disease, and diagnostic analysis. The search identified 1,078 records; 236 duplicates were removed, 842 unique records were screened, 258 full texts were assessed, and 123 studies were included after a record-level eligibility re-audit. Heterogeneous evidence was synthesized narratively and by descriptive mapping rather than meta-analysis. MRI was frequently represented in the included studies and auxiliary mapping data; CT was commonly used in acute stroke and intracranial hemorrhage; PET supported selected molecular and differential-diagnosis studies; fMRI and diffusion imaging were used for network and white-matter analysis; and EEG extended the scope to neurophysiological diagnosis. CNN and three-dimensional networks were commonly reported, while attention, Transformer, graph, self-supervised, generative, multimodal, and foundation-model approaches appeared in selected recent studies. Stroke, dementia, and brain tumors were frequently represented, but heterogeneous populations, outcomes, and incomplete validation extraction precluded ranking diseases, modalities, architectures, or validation strategies. The evidence suggests movement from task-specific pattern recognition toward multimodal and context-rich decision support in selected settings, but it does not establish uniform methodological superiority or clinical maturity. Dependable translation requires patient-level data governance, transparent reporting, uncertainty estimation, independent multicenter testing, prospective workflow evaluation, and clinically meaningful endpoints.
zh_abstract: [Frontiers in human neuroscience] 脑成像在神经系统疾病的结构、功能、代谢和神经生理学特征描述中处于核心地位，但其解读仍受到采集、标注、专业经验和临床背景异质性的制约。本系统文献综述评估了近期用于脑成像和计算机辅助诊断的人工智能方法，重点关注方法、模态、神经系统疾病、诊断任务、数据集、验证实践和转化局限。本综述遵循 PRISMA 2020，涵盖 2020 年 1 月至 2026 年 6 月发表的经同行评议的英文研究。使用针对各数据库的检索词（涉及人工智能、神经影像、神经系统疾病和诊断分析），检索了八个信息来源。检索共获得 1,078 条记录；去除 236 条重复记录，筛选 842 条唯一记录，评估 258 篇全文，在记录层面的纳入资格复核后最终纳入 123 项研究。异质性证据采用叙述性综合和描述性图谱的方式进行整合，而非荟萃分析。MRI 在纳入研究及辅助图谱数据中出现频率较高；CT 常用于急性卒中和颅内出血；PET 支持部分分子层面及鉴别诊断研究；fMRI 和扩散成像用于网络和白质分析；脑电图（EEG）则将范围扩展至神经生理学诊断。CNN 和三维网络被普遍报道，而注意力机制、Transformer、图、自监督、生成式、多模态和基础模型方法则出现在部分近期研究中。卒中、痴呆和脑肿瘤的出现频率较高，但由于人群、结局的异质性以及验证信息提取不完整，无法对疾病、模态、架构或验证策略进行排序。证据提示，在部分场景中，研究正从特定任务的模式识别转向多模态且富含情境信息的决策支持，但并不能确立统一的方法学优越性或临床成熟度。可靠的转化需要患者层面的数据治理、透明的报告、不确定性估计、独立的多中心检验、前瞻性工作流程评估以及具有临床意义的终点。

abstract: Synthesizing realistic tumors on medical images helps address data scarcity for clinical AI. Existing diffusion-based methods, however, lack fine-grained attribute-level controllability, closed-loop quality verification, and awareness of which morphological patterns are underrepresented in the target distribution. We present MATS, a multi-agent framework for text-controllable, cross-organ tumor synthesis. Given a target disease, MATS first profiles its morphological distribution over a fine-grained attribute space covering tumor geometry and appearance, and constructs a generation plan that amplifies underrepresented subtypes while keeping common ones dominant. It then localizes the target organ, proposes anatomically valid placement, and executes two-stage diffusion to produce the tumor mask and render texture, each conditioned on the corresponding attributes. A closed-loop reflective mechanism verifies attribute alignment at three checkpoints throughout synthesis and provides targeted feedback to guide re-generation when misalignment is detected. Trained exclusively on a single-source pancreatic neuroendocrine tumor dataset, MATS consistently improves downstream segmentation both in-domain and across LiTS, KiTS, and MSD-Pancreas benchmarks, whereas most prior generative augmentation methods fall below real-only training.
zh_abstract: 在医学图像上合成逼真的肿瘤有助于解决临床AI面临的数据稀缺问题。然而，现有基于扩散模型的方法缺乏细粒度的属性级可控性、闭环质量验证，以及对目标分布中哪些形态学模式代表性不足的感知。我们提出了MATS，一种用于文本可控的跨器官肿瘤合成的多智能体框架。给定目标疾病，MATS首先在涵盖肿瘤几何形态和外观的细粒度属性空间中刻画其形态学分布，并构建一个生成计划，在保持常见亚型占主导的同时，增加代表性不足亚型的比例。随后，它定位目标器官，提出符合解剖学的放置位置，并执行两阶段扩散以生成肿瘤掩膜并渲染纹理，每一阶段均以相应属性为条件。闭环反思机制在整个合成过程中的三个检查点验证属性对齐情况，并在发现不一致时提供有针对性的反馈以指导重新生成。MATS仅在单一来源的胰腺神经内分泌肿瘤数据集上训练，即可在域内以及LiTS、KiTS和MSD-Pancreas基准上持续提升下游分割性能，而大多数既往生成式数据增强方法的表现低于仅使用真实数据的训练。

title: Can Personal Requirements Become Supervision for Planning?
zh_title: 个人需求能否成为规划的监督信号？

abstract: Managing multiple chronic conditions through diet requires satisfying disease- and medication-specific requirements jointly across meals and days while preserving established eating habits. These requirements are public in clinical guidelines and drug labels, yet turning them into a feasible plan for one person remains difficult for language-model agents. In our dietitian-approved weekly planning evaluation built from NHANES, thirteen models, from medically fine-tuned 8B models to GPT-6.1 Sol, pass fewer than 3% of complete plans through direct generation. Explicit rules, higher reasoning effort, or model-directed tools leave GPT-6.1 Sol at no more than 8%. We present Noura, which pairs LLM planning with executable personal specifications instantiated from public clinical guidance and individual health and dietary profiles. During planning, the specification grounds foods, optimizes portions, checks the complete multi-day plan, and guides revision. Our key insight is that a specification that rejects a plan can also determine what to learn from it. Noura turns executed plans and contextually credited revisions into supervision for compact models, recovering targets even from trajectories that never achieve complete success. The same specification supplies supervised targets, preferences, and rewards for post-training. On 4,993 held-out participants, Noura-SFT raises Qwen3-14B's complete-plan pass rate from 24.0% to 72.5% within the same execution loop, cuts rule violations by 97.5% with no observed critical failures, and improves dietary quality. The locally hosted 14B planner incurs fewer rule violations than its GPT-6 Luna teacher. A matched comparison shows that executed targets reduce rule violations by 41% over model-written proposals. Across four Qwen, Phi, and Llama backbones, self-training alone reduces rule violations by 41-61% on a 1,249-person population subset.
zh_abstract: 通过饮食管理多种慢性病，需要在各餐次和各日之间共同满足针对疾病和药物的特定要求，同时保留既有的饮食习惯。这些要求在临床指南和药品说明书中是公开的，但将其转化为适合个体的可行方案，对语言模型智能体而言仍然困难。在我们基于NHANES构建、经营养师认可的每周饮食计划评估中，13个模型（从经医学微调的8B模型到GPT-6.1 Sol）通过直接生成得到的完整计划，通过率均低于3%。使用明确规则、更高的推理强度或由模型指导的工具，GPT-6.1 Sol的通过率也不超过8%。我们提出了Noura，它将大语言模型（LLM）规划与可执行的个人规范相结合，这些规范由公开的临床指导意见以及个人健康和饮食档案实例化而来。在规划过程中，该规范用于确定食物、优化份量、检查完整的多日计划并指导修订。我们的关键见解是：能够否决某一计划的规范，同样可以确定应从该计划中学习什么。Noura将已执行的计划以及结合上下文给予认可的修订转化为对紧凑模型的监督信号，即使是从从未完全成功的轨迹中也能恢复目标。同一规范还为后训练提供监督目标、偏好和奖励。在4,993名留出参与者中，Noura-SFT在相同的执行循环内将Qwen3-14B的完整计划通过率从24.0%提高到72.5%，将规则违反减少97.5%，且未观察到严重失败，并改善了饮食质量。本地部署的14B规划器产生的规则违反少于其教师模型GPT-6 Luna。一项匹配比较显示，与模型撰写的方案相比，已执行的目标使规则违反减少41%。在四个Qwen、Phi和Llama骨干模型上，仅自我训练即可在1,249人的人群子集上将规则违反减少41-61%。

title: Segment Anything Pancreas: A Unified MRI Segmentation Model for Pancreatic Cancer Radiotherapy
zh_title: Segment Anything Pancreas：胰腺癌放疗的统一MRI分割模型
summary: 提出Pancreas-MedNeXt，在单个MRI体数据上统一分割胰腺及亚区、肿瘤和周围危及器官，并用标注感知损失处理部分标注数据。
key_points: 共享MedNeXt编码器-解码器，三个输出头
标注感知损失可训练部分标注数据
在PANTHER、Cyst-X、AMOS等数据评估
reason: 预印本，多数据集评估，对放疗有实用性，但样本量有限
abstract: Background: Limited tumor annotations and incomplete labels across MRI datasets hinder unified segmentation of pancreatic tumors and organs at risk (OARs) for MRI-guided radiotherapy. Purpose: We propose Pancreas-MedNeXt, a unified model that segments the whole pancreas, its subregions, tumors, and surrounding OARs from one MRI volume. Methods: The model uses a shared MedNeXt encoder-decoder with supervised whole-pancreas and subregion pretraining, followed by multitask fine-tuning. Three output heads predict the pancreatic subregions, tumor, and OARs (stomach, duodenum, kidneys). An annotation-aware loss allows training on partially labeled data without treating unannotated structures as background. Pancreas and tumor were evaluated by three-fold cross-validation on 142 PANTHER patients (92 diagnostic, 50 MR-Linac), subregions and OARs on Cyst-X and AMOS test sets, and pancreas and OARs on 33 external T1-weighted TotalSegmentator scans. Comparisons with nnU-Net, MedNeXt, VISTA3D, and Swin UNETR used the Dice similarity coefficient (DSC) with paired bootstrap 95% CIs. Results: Pancreas-MedNeXt achieved the highest mean pancreas and tumor DSC on diagnostic and MR-Linac MRI. Tumor DSC was 58.41% and 42.55%, exceeding task-specific MedNeXt by 4.94 (95% CI: 0.28-9.45) and 5.89 (95% CI: 2.37-9.72) percentage points, respectively. Whole-pancreas DSC was 85.73% and 70.66%. Pretraining improved head, body, and tail DSC by 2.01, 3.00, and 3.78 percentage points over training from scratch. It also achieved the highest DSC for the pancreas, duodenum, and right kidney on AMOS, and for all five organs on external MRI, exceeding the next-best method by 4.92-8.85 percentage points.Conclusion: A single Pancreas-MedNeXt model segments tumors, pancreatic subregions, and OARs on diagnostic and MR-Linac MRI, which could streamline contouring for pancreatic cancer radiotherapy.
zh_abstract: 【背景】MRI数据集中肿瘤标注有限且标签不完整，阻碍了用于MRI引导放疗的胰腺肿瘤和危及器官（OAR）的统一分割。【目的】我们提出Pancreas-MedNeXt，一种可从单个MRI容积中分割整个胰腺及其亚区、肿瘤和周围OAR的统一模型。【方法】该模型采用共享的MedNeXt编码器-解码器，先进行有监督的全胰腺及亚区预训练，再进行多任务微调。三个输出头分别预测胰腺亚区、肿瘤和OAR（胃、十二指肠、肾脏）。一种标注感知损失函数使模型可在部分标注数据上训练，而不会将未标注结构视为背景。胰腺和肿瘤通过对142例PANTHER患者（92例诊断性MRI，50例MR-Linac）进行三折交叉验证来评估，亚区和OAR在Cyst-X和AMOS测试集上评估，胰腺和OAR在33例外部T1加权TotalSegmentator扫描上评估。与nnU-Net、MedNeXt、VISTA3D和Swin UNETR的比较采用Dice相似系数（DSC）及配对bootstrap 95% CI。【结果】Pancreas-MedNeXt在诊断性MRI和MR-Linac MRI上获得了最高的平均胰腺和肿瘤DSC。肿瘤DSC分别为58.41%和42.55%，分别比任务专用MedNeXt高4.94个百分点（95% CI：0.28-9.45）和5.89个百分点（95% CI：2.37-9.72）。全胰腺DSC分别为85.73%和70.66%。预训练使胰头、胰体和胰尾的DSC较从头训练分别提高了2.01、3.00和3.78个百分点。在AMOS上，该模型在胰腺、十二指肠和右肾方面也取得了最高DSC；在外部MRI上，五个器官的DSC均为最高，比次优方法高4.92-8.85个百分点。【结论】单一的Pancreas-MedNeXt模型即可在诊断性MRI和MR-Linac MRI上分割肿瘤、胰腺亚区和OAR，有望简化胰腺癌放疗的勾画工作。

title: Single-Annotation, Multi-Hypothesis Segmentation with Semantic-Spatial Residual Banks
zh_title: 单标注多假设分割：语义-空间残差库
summary: 预印本：针对每图仅有一个标注的训练集，提出SSRB，在五个医学终点上提升对留出标注的覆盖度，优于Probabilistic U-Net。
key_points: 训练仅用单一掩码，测试需覆盖多位标注者
冻结语义库并学习图像残差
五个医学终点上K=8覆盖度提升
reason: 有基线对比的新方法预印本，证据有限，属值得一看档
abstract: Multi-rater segmentation datasets show that a single image can admit several valid masks, yet most training sets expose only one annotation per image. We study single-annotation multi-hypothesis segmentation: each training image exposes one fixed mask, while the model must return a finite bank that covers held-out human annotations at test time. Our experiments reveal a representation tradeoff. Banks learned directly from images recover variations in local boundaries and extent but lose structural hypotheses, whereas frozen semantic features preserve structural grouping but underrepresent spatial variation. We introduce the Semantic-Spatial Residual Bank (SSRB), which freezes a semantic bank trained with balanced assignments and learns a residual from the image for each hypothesis. Across five medical endpoints, SSRB improves coverage of held-out masks at $K=8$ over a Probabilistic U-Net under the same one-mask constraint. On LIDC and LIDC-hard, it also produces substantially more distinct useful masks. On BSDS, it preserves the semantic bank's performance in grouping regions. Its advantage grows as more masks are returned, showing that residuals learned for corresponding heads improve coverage of local annotation variation while preserving how regions are grouped.
zh_abstract: 多评审者分割数据集表明，单张图像可以对应多个有效的分割掩码，但大多数训练集中每张图像只提供一个标注。我们研究单标注多假设分割：每张训练图像仅提供一个固定掩码，而模型在测试时必须返回一个有限的掩码集合（bank），以覆盖留出的人工标注。我们的实验揭示了一种表征上的权衡。直接从图像学习得到的掩码集合能够恢复局部边界和范围上的变化，但会丢失结构性假设；而冻结的语义特征保留了结构性分组，但对空间变化的表达不足。我们提出语义-空间残差库（Semantic-Spatial Residual Bank，SSRB），它冻结一个以均衡分配方式训练的语义库，并针对每个假设从图像中学习一个残差。在五个医学终点任务上，在相同的单掩码约束下，SSRB 在 $K=8$ 时对留出掩码的覆盖率优于概率 U-Net（Probabilistic U-Net）。在 LIDC 和 LIDC-hard 上，它还能产生明显更多彼此不同且有用的掩码。在 BSDS 上，它保持了语义库在区域分组方面的性能。随着返回掩码数量的增加，其优势不断扩大，这表明针对相应头（head）学习的残差在保留区域分组方式的同时，提高了对局部标注变化的覆盖。

title: LAPIS: Clinically Constrained Patient-Identity Residual Learning for Chest X-Ray Anonymization
zh_title: LAPIS：胸片匿名化的临床约束患者身份残差学习
summary: 提出在潜空间中将身份信息集中于可替换残差通道的胸片匿名化方法，在ChestX-ray14上以适配攻击者评估（预印本）。
key_points: 半正交基定义身份残差，对抗抑制泄漏
替换感知训练，用供体残差混合替换
在患者不重叠划分上评估再识别攻击
reason: 隐私新方法预印本，有攻击者评估，单数据集
abstract: Biometric information in chest radiographs limits their release for research, as patients can be re-identified. We propose LAPIS, which jointly adapts a spatial chest-radiograph latent space so that patient-discriminative information concentrates in a compact, replaceable channel residual while most clinically relevant content stays in the complement. The residual is defined by an exactly semi-orthogonal basis, a spatial adversary suppresses identity leakage from the complement, and replacement-aware training teaches the decoder cross-patient residual swaps under output identity, clinical and realism constraints, so that replacing the residual yields a valid image. At release, the residual is replaced by a mixture of donor residuals. On patient-disjoint model, release and test sets from ChestX-ray14, we evaluate attackers adapted to the anonymized setting, a structural source-retrieval attack, and pathology classifiers trained on released images and tested on real ones. LAPIS reduces worst-case cross-study linkability from 0.961 to 0.791 AUC at a macro AUROC cost of 0.012 relative to reconstruction; a deformation-based baseline, however, remains better at structural source retrieval.
zh_abstract: 胸部X线片中的生物特征信息会导致患者可被重新识别，从而限制了其用于研究的公开发布。我们提出LAPIS，该方法联合调整胸部X线片的空间潜在空间，使具有患者区分性的信息集中于一个紧凑、可替换的通道残差中，而大部分临床相关内容保留在其补空间中。该残差由一个精确半正交基定义，空间对抗器抑制补空间中的身份信息泄露，并通过感知替换的训练使解码器在输出身份、临床及真实感约束下学习跨患者残差互换，从而使替换残差后得到有效图像。发布时，残差被替换为多个供体残差的混合。在ChestX-ray14中患者互不重叠的模型集、发布集和测试集上，我们评估了适应匿名化场景的攻击者、结构性来源检索攻击，以及在发布图像上训练、在真实图像上测试的病理分类器。相对于重建方法，LAPIS将最坏情况下的跨研究可关联性AUC从0.961降至0.791，宏平均AUROC代价为0.012；然而，基于形变的基线方法在结构性来源检索方面仍表现更好。

title: CS-LDM: Clinically Guided Structure-Aware Latent Diffusion for Knee Radiographic Forecasting
zh_title: CS-LDM：临床引导的结构感知潜在扩散膝关节X线预测
summary: 提出CS-LDM，根据当前X线片和KL分级生成患者未来膝关节X线，用LoRA、分级条件和冻结教师诊断蒸馏保证形态可靠。
key_points: 针对膝骨关节炎进展的影像预测
采用LoRA适配与当前分级条件
以诊断蒸馏约束生成结构的可靠性
reason: 预印本，生成式预后预测有新意，摘要无具体结果与外部验证
abstract: Knee osteoarthritis (KOA) is a leading cause of physical disability and currently has no curative clinical treatment. Early diagnosis and accurate prognosis are therefore vital for managing its progression. Existing methods mainly predict future severity grades and provide limited visual explanation of structural change. Recent generation-guided approaches synthesize follow-up radiographs for progression assessment, but generated images are often judged by predictive accuracy or image realism, so they may satisfy a grading model while remaining morphologically unreliable. We therefore propose CS-LDM, a clinically guided, structure-aware latent diffusion framework that forecasts patient-specific future knee radiographs from the current X-ray and clinically available current KL grade, using LoRA adaptation, current-grade conditioning, and frozen-teacher diagnostic distillation. Experiments on the public Osteoarthritis Initiative (OAI) dataset show that CS-LDM improves future severity-grade consistency while maintaining competitive image fidelity. Further ordinal, OARSI, ROI-level, and stable/progressed analyses show that radiographic forecasting should be evaluated by balancing diagnostic consistency, anatomical plausibility, and structural preservation.

title: DiffUltra: Task-Guided Pathology Synthesis for Large-Scale Real-World Lung Ultrasound Data
zh_title: DiffUltra：面向真实肺超声数据的任务引导病理合成
summary: 提出任务引导的潜在扩散流程，基于结构掩码生成肺超声病变图像，并用仅在真实数据上训练的过滤器筛选合成图像（预印本）。
key_points: 按无回声/低回声/高回声子区域的结构掩码条件生成
两种放置策略：插入无病变背景或替换已有病变
用真实数据训练的过滤器筛选下游可用图像
reason: 新颖的超声合成方法，但摘要证据有限，属值得一看档
abstract: Despite their scale, large medical imaging datasets may underrepresent clinically relevant pathological presentations. Synthetic data can expand coverage, but findings must remain compatible with surrounding anatomy. This is challenging in ultrasound, where findings resemble surrounding tissue and must be positioned relative to anatomical landmarks. We propose DiffUltra, a task-guided latent diffusion pipeline that models pathological structure and spatial context, and screens synthetic images for downstream utility. DiffUltra conditions generation on structural masks decomposing findings into anechoic, hypoechoic, and hyperechoic subregions. Two placement strategies insert findings into pathology-absent backgrounds or replace existing findings with structurally matched pathology from other patients. A filter trained exclusively on real data retains images whose predictions agree spatially with target boxes. We evaluate DiffUltra for lung ultrasound detection of pleural effusion and consolidation, using over 700,000 expert-annotated frames from 598 patients at 12 sites. Averaged across three real-data scales, synthetic insertion significantly improved video-level AUROC for both pleural effusion (p = 0.017) and consolidation (p < 0.01). For pleural effusion, frame-level average precision improved by 4.5 percentage points on average and by 6.1 points using only 10% of real data (p < 0.01 for both). Synthetic insertion also yielded larger average precision gains than an existing diffusion-based lesion-insertion method at every scale. At full scale, targeted synthesis improved AUROC for both pathologies by 1.1-3.9 points in an underrepresented anatomical zone and on a held-out acquisition system. These results suggest that anatomically constrained, task-guided synthesis can help address coverage gaps in ultrasound training data.

title: Report-Derived Labels, an Image Teacher and the Gap to Expert Labels in Knee MRI: An Analysis of One Entry to the RSNA 2026 Knee Abnormality Detection Challenge
zh_title: 膝关节MRI：报告标签、图像教师与专家标签的差距
summary: 在RSNA 2026膝关节异常检测挑战中，比较LLM读报告生成的标签与图像模型预测对专家标签的一致性，二者宏AUC相近但失败的发现不同（预印本）。
key_points: 仅58/4407例有专家标签
报告标签与图像模型宏AUC为0.892与0.896
两者在不同病变上各有优劣
reason: 弱监督标签分析有参考价值，但为单一挑战条目、数据小
abstract: In the RSNA 2026 Knee Abnormality Detection challenge, 58 of 4,407 training studies have expert labels for 12 findings, and the rest have only a radiology report. We compare training targets built from a language-model reading of the reports and from a public image model against two references: the expert labels and the 39,248 study-finding cells that the reports state as present or absent. The report labels and the out-of-fold predictions of the image model reach similar agreement with the expert labels (macro AUC 0.892 and 0.896) but fail on different findings. The report is better for ligament tears and patellofemoral osteoarthritis, which it never calls present when the experts do not; the image model is better for effusion, Baker's cyst, contusion, and synovitis, where the reports call the finding absent, leave it out, or call it present more often than the experts. Their equal mixture reaches 0.927 (gain over the report labels 0.035, 95% interval 0.019 to 0.052), also after removing the studies whose knee side was handled inconsistently. We did not observe a model-level gain from this better target: a 2.5D ResNet50 trained on the report labels alone scored 0.877 on the private leaderboard, after the deadline, against 0.872 for the same model trained on the mixture, and the out-of-fold advantage of the mixture is confounded by a change of code and by possible leakage through the image model's folds. A scanner prevalence prior raised agreement with the reports but not with the experts, so a report-derived reference can reward reporting habits. A rank correction for co-occurring findings gave small out-of-fold gains and no visible leaderboard effect. Our entry, a forked public ensemble with that correction, was displayed at rank 582 of 6,299 on the private leaderboard (0.943, a score shared by 287 teams). All results are exploratory; none of the models is meant for clinical use.

title: TheseusSyn: Unified Medical Image Synthesis via Context-Conditioned Masked Autoregression
zh_title: TheseusSyn：基于上下文条件掩码自回归的统一医学图像合成
summary: 预印本：提出多码本离散分词器加掩码自回归模型，以全局上下文为条件，通过迭代内容替换合成医学图像。
key_points: 多码本离散分词器将图像转为token序列
以全局表示token作为上下文约束
通过逐步替换内容生成完整图像
reason: 有新意的生成方法预印本，摘要未见充分对比与外部验证，属值得一看档
abstract: High-fidelity medical image synthesis is promising for data-efficient learning and privacy-preserving model development. However, most existing approaches rely on symbolic or label-based conditioning, which constrains generative diversity and limits case-specific contextual fidelity. Inspired by the Ship of Theseus paradox, we propose TheseusSyn, a novel context-conditioned synthesis paradigm that generates images through iterative content replacement. Our framework employs a multi-codebook discrete tokenizer to convert medical images into sequences of token indices, extracted with a global representation token that serves as a contextual constraint. A masked autoregressive generative model then iteratively masks and predicts tokens conditioned on both local neighborhoods and the global context. By progressively replacing image content until the entire token sequence is renewed, TheseusSyn produces synthetic samples that preserve anatomical coherence and semantic consistency while introducing controlled diversity. We evaluate the proposed framework on multiple datasets from MedMNIST by constructing synthetic datasets with varying masking strategies and training ResNet-18 classifiers exclusively on either real or synthetic data. Experimental results demonstrate that classifiers trained on TheseusSyn-generated images achieve competitive performance on official test sets, indicating that the synthesized data preserve diagnostically relevant features and semantic consistency. Systematic analysis of masking strategies reveals their impact on structural fidelity and downstream classification accuracy. These results suggest that context-conditioned masked autoregression provides an effective and generalizable solution for label-free medical image synthesis, offering a scalable alternative to conventional data augmentation and class-conditioned generative models in medical imaging applications.
zh_abstract: 高保真医学图像合成对于数据高效学习和保护隐私的模型开发具有前景。然而，现有大多数方法依赖符号或基于标签的条件，这限制了生成多样性，并削弱了针对具体病例的上下文保真度。受忒修斯之船悖论的启发，我们提出 TheseusSyn，这是一种新颖的上下文条件合成范式，通过迭代的内容替换生成图像。我们的框架采用多码本离散分词器将医学图像转换为词元索引序列，并提取一个全局表示词元作为上下文约束。随后，掩码自回归生成模型在局部邻域和全局上下文的共同条件下，迭代地掩蔽并预测词元。通过逐步替换图像内容直至整个词元序列被更新，TheseusSyn 生成的合成样本在引入可控多样性的同时，保持了解剖结构的连贯性和语义一致性。我们在 MedMNIST 的多个数据集上评估了所提框架：采用不同的掩码策略构建合成数据集，并仅使用真实数据或合成数据训练 ResNet-18 分类器。实验结果表明，在 TheseusSyn 生成图像上训练的分类器在官方测试集上取得了具有竞争力的性能，说明合成数据保留了具有诊断意义的特征和语义一致性。对掩码策略的系统分析揭示了其对结构保真度和下游分类准确率的影响。这些结果表明，上下文条件掩码自回归为无标签医学图像合成提供了一种有效且可推广的解决方案，为医学影像应用中的传统数据增强和类别条件生成模型提供了一种可扩展的替代方案。

title: Artificial Intelligence-Based Three-Dimensional Preoperative Planning for Total Knee Arthroplasty in End-Stage Knee Osteoarthritis​.
source: PubMed · Journal of visualized experiments : JoVE
zh_title: AI三维术前规划用于终末期膝骨关节炎全膝置换
summary: 单中心回顾性初步研究，评估AIKNEE系统预测假体尺寸和部件位置的可靠性，纳入24例患者28膝。
key_points: 主要结局为计划与实际假体尺寸一致性
次要结局含HKA角与HSS评分
reason: 单中心小样本回顾性、无外部验证，属增量档
abstract: [Journal of visualized experiments : JoVE] Accurate preoperative templating for total knee arthroplasty (TKA) in patients with end-stage knee osteoarthritis (KOA) remains challenging, and the accuracy of conventional planning methods is variable. This preliminary, retrospective, single-center study evaluated the reliability of a robot-independent, artificial intelligence (AI)-based, three-dimensional (3D) preoperative planning system (AIKNEE) for predicting prosthesis size and component position in patients undergoing TKA for end-stage KOA. Twenty-eight knees from 24 patients with Kellgren-Lawrence grade 3-4 KOA were included. The primary outcome was the agreement between the planned and implanted prosthesis sizes. Secondary outcomes included correction of the coronal hip-knee-ankle (HKA) angle, improvement in Hospital for Special Surgery (HSS) knee scores, and early postoperative complications. The planned size matched the implanted size exactly in 53.57% of femoral components (15/28; 95% confidence interval [CI], 35.8%-70.5%) and 46.43% of tibial components (13/28; 95% CI, 29.5%-64.2%). Agreement within ±1 size was 85.71% for femoral components (24/28; 95% CI, 68.5%-94.3%) and 96.43% for tibial components (27/28; 95% CI, 82.3%-99.4%), giving an overall matching rate of 91.07% (51/56; 95% CI, 80.7%-96.1%). The postoperative HKA angle improved from 173.0° ± 3.9° to 178.2° ± 1.2° (P < 0.001), and the HSS score increased from 39.7 ± 2.2 preoperatively to 80.8 ± 1.3 at the 1-month follow-up (P < 0.001). No major early complications, including infection, dislocation, or deep venous thrombosis, were observed. Within this preliminary cohort, the AIKNEE system predicted prosthesis size with a reliability comparable to that reported for existing AI templating tools. Because the study was retrospective, single-arm, unblinded, and limited to 1 month of follow-up, these data characterize planning accuracy only and do not demonstrate clinical effectiveness; adequately powered, controlled studies with long-term follow-up are required.
zh_abstract: [Journal of visualized experiments:JoVE] 对终末期膝骨关节炎(KOA)患者进行全膝关节置换术(TKA)的术前精确模板测量仍具挑战,传统规划方法的准确性不一。这项初步的回顾性单中心研究评估了一种不依赖机器人的、基于人工智能(AI)的三维(3D)术前规划系统(AIKNEE)在预测终末期KOA患者TKA假体尺寸和部件位置方面的可靠性。纳入24例患者的28个膝关节,Kellgren-Lawrence分级为3-4级。主要结局为规划假体尺寸与实际植入假体尺寸的一致性。次要结局包括冠状面髋-膝-踝(HKA)角的矫正、特种外科医院(HSS)膝关节评分的改善以及术后早期并发症。规划尺寸与实际植入尺寸完全一致的比例,股骨部件为53.57%(15/28;95%置信区间[CI],35.8%-70.5%),胫骨部件为46.43%(13/28;95% CI,29.5%-64.2%)。在±1个尺寸范围内一致的比例,股骨部件为85.71%(24/28;95% CI,68.5%-94.3%),胫骨部件为96.43%(27/28;95% CI,82.3%-99.4%),总体匹配率为91.07%(51/56;95% CI,80.7%-96.1%)。术后HKA角由173.0° ± 3.9°改善至178.2° ± 1.2°(P < 0.001),HSS评分由术前39.7 ± 2.2升至术后1个月随访时的80.8 ± 1.3(P < 0.001)。未观察到包括感染、脱位或深静脉血栓形成在内的严重早期并发症。在这一初步队列中,AIKNEE系统预测假体尺寸的可靠性与已报道的现有AI模板测量工具相当。由于本研究为回顾性、单臂、非盲法,且随访仅限于1个月,这些数据仅反映规划准确性,并不能证明临床有效性;需要有充分检验效能、含对照且长期随访的研究。
